name: Integrity Rotational Molding
old_description: Let us help bring your product vision to life with quality rotational molding solutions that fit your budget and your expectations.
about:
Integrity Rotational Molding operates from Plainfield, Indiana. The company is led by Owner/CEO Terry Stemple alongside a leadership team that includes family members Chris Stemple, Terra Stemple-Patterson, and Zach Stemple. No founding year is publicly disclosed.

The shop provides full-service rotational molding, covering design and engineering, tooling fabrication, molding, finishing, secondary operations (trimming, machining, inserts, hardware, welding, decoration), assembly, packaging, and industrial roto-lining. It runs a custom operation producing over 184 distinct parts for more than 47 customers across the United States, Canada, Germany, and Ireland.

Customers come from agricultural, automotive, waste disposal, advertising, shipping, safety, aerospace and defense, server and telecommunications, and marine and recreational sectors. Typical parts include automotive dunnage, storage tanks, material handling equipment, server housings, and complex multi-wall structures.

The company positions itself as the most referred custom rotational molder in the industry, emphasizing a proprietary problem-solving approach for tight tolerances, complex geometries, and difficult materials that other molders turn away.
